The flowers are not alone; they are accompanied by a smattering of leaves, their green hues providing a stark contrast to the predominantly white and blue palette. The leaves are scattered throughout the arrangement, some nestled among the petals while others peek out from the edges, creating a sense of depth and dimension.

The entire arrangement is set against a dark blue backdrop, which serves to highlight the flowers and leaves, making them stand out even more. The dark blue color also adds a sense of tranquility and calmness to the scene, complementing the delicate beauty of the flowers.

Overall, the image is a harmonious blend of colors and shapes, with each element - the white flowers, the blue-tipped petals, the green leaves, and the dark blue background - contributing to a visually pleasing and serene composition.
